title: torchtest2: One-Call Sanity Checks for PyTorch Models,Evaluated on Real and Unseen Architectures
abstract: arXiv:2611.23273v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many bugs in deep learning code are silent: a layer that is never called, an optimizer created before the classification head was replaced, a recurrent layer that treats the batch as time, or an ignored attention mask. The code runs, the loss decreases somewhat, and the defect surfaces, if ever, after days of GPU time. We present torchtest2, an open-source library that runs 18 sanity checks on a single batch with one call, restores the PyTorch state it touches, and adapts to model families through plugins. We evaluate it by mutation analysis with 17 classes of silent bugs on 103 models from torchvision, timm and Hugging Face transformers, on 600 random architectures and on 20 hand-written realistic bugs, against the checks of the original torchtest, overfitting a single batch, a smoke test and a training monitor in the style of AUTOTRAINER and DeepDiagnosis. translated_title: torchtest2：一次调用即可完成的 PyTorch 模型健全性检查，并在真实与未见过的架构上进行评估
translated_abstract: 深度学习代码中的许多 bug 是无声的：一个从未被调用的层、一个在分类头被替换之前创建的优化器、一个把批次维度当作时间步处理的循环层，或者一个被忽略的注意力掩码。代码能够运行，损失也有所下降，而缺陷往往要等到消耗了数天的 GPU 时间后才会暴露出来（如果能够暴露的话）。我们提出了 torchtest2，这是一个开源库，只需一次调用即可在单个批次上运行 18 项健全性检查，能够恢复其所触及的 PyTorch 状态，并通过插件适配不同的模型家族。我们通过变异分析对其进行评估：在来自 torchvision、timm 和 Hugging Face transformers 的 103 个模型上注入 17 类无声 bug，在 600 个随机架构上进行测试，并使用 20 个人工编写的真实 bug，与原始 torchtest 的检查、单批次过拟合、冒烟测试以及 AUTOTRAINER 和 DeepDiagnosis 风格的训练监控器进行对比。每个变异体都与其健康的对应版本进行比较，置信区间来自……
tldr: torchtest2 是一个开源库，只需一次调用即可对 PyTorch 模型执行 18 项健全性检查以捕获无声 bug，并通过在 103 个真实模型、600 个随机架构和 20 个真实 bug 上的变异分析验证了其有效性。
en_tdlr: torchtest2 is an open-source library that catches silent bugs in PyTorch models via 18 one-call sanity checks, validated through mutation analysis on 103 real models, 600 random architectures, and 20 realistic bugs.
